text:
maria: Quick sync — I'm starting onboarding for phoenix-3B-v2. Weights uploaded to s3 but ran into two issues during the smoke / golden checks. pinging the group.

jin: thanks. which s3 path? and what's failing in golden checks?

maria: path: s3://redwood-weights/phoenix/3b/v2/weights.tar.gz
first failure: tokenizer maps our PAD token to id 0 which conflicts with special-0 behavior (truncation in long prompts). second: structured-toolcall golden prompts drop the `tools` field intermittently.

samantha: ugh. PAD=0 is a classic. Is this sentencepiece or json vocab?

maria: sentencepiece model + vocab.json. the tokenizer config we got looks like this:
```
{
  "tokenizer": "sentencepiece",
  "vocab": "vocab.json",
  "special_tokens": {"pad_token": "<|pad|>", "bos_token": "<|bos|>"},
  "pad_token_id": 0
}
```

leo: can we remap pad_token_id to 1 and update the tokenizer config before staging? should be a 2-line change in the packager.

prateek: changing pad id is fine but watch for any downstream evals that assume pad=0. we should add a compatibility shim in the tokenizer loader.

maria: agreed. i'll add the shim and a test. second issue: golden structured eval — some tool calls are being serialized wrong. example run snippet:
```
./scripts/run_golden_eval.sh phoenix-3B-v2 --subset=structured --workers=4
```
CI job: https://ci.redwood.internal/pipelines/phoenix-3b-v2/1234 (failing steps 7-8)

jin: looking at logs — the model emits a tool call but the `arguments` object comes back as a stringified JSON inside the `output` field instead of a separate `tools` list. seems model output formatting differs from earlier phoenix variants.

leo: that could be from a prompt-template mismatch. did we use the latest structured-output prompt wrapper?

maria: we used legacy wrapper. i can re-run with the new wrapper (structured_v2) in the eval harness. re-run command:
```
./scripts/run_golden_eval.sh phoenix-3B-v2 --prompt-template=structured_v2 --subset=structured
```

ops-bot: scheduled rerun for phoenix-3B-v2 with structured_v2 at 2026-03-18T02:30:00Z :white_check_mark:

prateek: also open a small lint rule in the model config validator: require `structured_output_schema` when `tool_calling` is enabled. Caught us in prior rollouts.

maria: will do the validator patch and push a PR. pinging @jin for review once up.

jin: on it. quick ask: can we also capture one failing example (input + model output) in the ticket? makes debugging faster.

maria: copied failing example into the ticket (#3456). sample:
```
input: "Look up user 123 and call the billing tool"
model_output: "{\"action\": \"call_tool\", \"payload\": \"{\\\"tool\\\":\\\"billing\\\",\\\"id\\\":123}\"}"
```

leo: thanks. that shows nested-stringification. likely tokenizer didn't preserve curly braces or the model generation policy collapsed spacing.

prateek: ETA for the tokenizer shim + validator + rerun?

maria: shim + test by EOD today, PR for validator early tomorrow, rerun scheduled by ops-bot after shim merges.

jin: i'll prioritize the review once PR hits. can we also add a quick golden check to the staging deploy job so this fails fast next time?

maria: yes — i'll add a lightweight structured smoke (5 prompts) to staging pipeline.

ops-bot: note: canary window open 2026-03-18 22:00-23:00 PST if all green. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

leo: pinging @samantha for packaging CR too (weights path change + tokenizer config).

samantha: got it — i'll review packaging changes and push an updated release tar by tomorrow morning. :+1:

maria: thank you all. i'll update the ticket and close this thread once canary passes. :v:
